correctness.rationale: The all-m proof reduces every graph to a complete realization of possible traces, counts unique endpoint stars and legitimate pair unions, removes forbidden marked-edge pairs and P3 collisions, and bounds the star signature count by component deficits. Both parities and all small exceptions receive explicit equality analysis. Additional P4 collision prevents a false equality case. The standalone finite checker passed 215896 full instances; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This identifies the exact worst-case capacity of all external adjacency one-types in the important graph class of line graphs, along with rigidity of every extremizing marked-edge configuration. The coefficient 9/8, parity effect and exceptional small case show that matching marks are not extremal and that the graph-class constraint has a precise structural consequence.
